questions.q: What does a utility token's value typically come from, per this lesson?
options: Controlling future protocol decisions
Owning a share of the protocol's legal entity
Needing the token to perform a function (gas, access, collateral, discounts) inside the protocol
Nothing -- utility tokens have no value by definition
questions.explain: A utility token's value comes from needing it to do something inside the protocol, not from any voting rights.

questions.q: Which of these is a governance token function, not a utility token function?
options: Voting on parameter changes like interest rate curves or emission schedules
Paying gas for a transaction
Being staked as collateral to validate
Unlocking a discount on protocol fees
questions.explain: Voting on parameter changes is a governance function -- it grants a say over the protocol, unlike utility functions like gas, collateral, or discounts.

questions.q: According to this lesson, are most real-world tokens purely utility or purely governance?
options: Yes, every token is strictly one or the other
Governance tokens never have any utility function
Utility tokens always grant full voting rights
No -- most real tokens are hybrids that do both jobs (and often capture fee value too)
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly notes that very few tokens are purely one or the other -- a single token commonly serves staking, voting, and value-accrual roles simultaneously.

options: A toggle that turns off all protocol fees permanently
A governance-controlled mechanism that routes a share of protocol revenue to token holders, usually via buyback-and-burn
A fixed, non-adjustable protocol rule set at launch
A mechanism exclusive to utility tokens with no governance involvement
questions.explain: A fee switch is a governance decision that routes protocol revenue (often via buyback-and-burn) to benefit token holders.

questions.q: A protocol collects $500,000 in fees and governance routes 20% to the fee switch, with the token priced at $2.50. How many tokens get burned?
options: 40,000 tokens
100,000 tokens
500,000 tokens
200,000 tokens
